question: A customer on a monthly plan was charged 10 days ago and wants their money back. Are they eligible, and how do they ask for it?

documents.title: Acme Cloud refund policy
documents.text: Acme Cloud customers on monthly plans can request a full refund within 14 days of the first charge. Annual plans are refundable pro rata within the first 30 days. Refunds are never issued for usage-based overage charges. Requests go through the billing portal and are processed within 5 business days.

expected_points: eligible: within the 14-day window for monthly plans
request goes through the billing portal

question: Enterprise uptime last month was 98.7%. What compensation is the customer owed and what must they do?

documents.title: Acme Cloud SLA
documents.text: The Business tier guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime; the Enterprise tier guarantees 99.95%. If uptime falls below the guarantee, customers receive service credits: 10% of the monthly fee below the target and 25% below 99.0%. Credits must be claimed within 30 days of the incident. Scheduled maintenance announced 72 hours in advance does not count as downtime.

expected_points: must be claimed within 30 days of the incident

question: The checkout API is down for all customers. Walk me through what our on-call process requires in the first hour.

documents.title: Platform on-call runbook
documents.text: Severity 1 means customer-facing outage or data loss. The primary on-call acknowledges a SEV1 page within 5 minutes and opens an incident channel. The incident commander posts status updates every 30 minutes. A blameless postmortem is due within 5 business days of resolution.

question: ¿Cuánto tiempo guardamos los logs de auditoría y los backups de clientes?

documents.title: Data retention policy
documents.text: Application logs are kept for 30 days. Audit logs are kept for 1 year. Customer backups are kept for 35 days and are encrypted with AES-256. When a customer closes an account, their data is deleted within 60 days.
